solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 4'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the context of the French Revolution, the word that best fits the blank is one that indicates the removal or abolition of feudal privileges.
 
• **"Elimination" **means the complete removal or eradication of something.(समाप्ति)
 
• The French Revolution aimed to eliminate feudal privileges and establish more equitable systems.
 
• Hence, the most appropriate word is** ****"elimination".**

Therefore, the correct answer is -** 'Option 4'.**
